notes.itemTitle: Plan Locus exit: notice, LWD, handover
notes.title: Notice sent, LWD 6 Dec
notes.text: You sent your resignation yesterday with a full two-month notice, so your last working day is 6 December. I moved this task from 15 November to that date, since the handover runs right up to it.

notes.itemTitle: Close the KITAS and withdraw BPJS
notes.title: KITAS expires 8 Nov
notes.text: You move to India on 7 November because your KITAS expires the next day, and you asked Locus to handle the closure and your BPJS withdrawal through InCorp. None of that was on the board, so it is a task now, dated to the expiry. - You are still waiting on InCorp's revised quote.
